title: Included Mileage Schedule and Excess Mileage Rates for Car Hire
content:
Mileage on Wanderlane car hire is either included without limit or granted as an allowance of miles for
each rental day, with a rate for each mile driven beyond it. The six Car Rental Rate Classes divide as
follows.

| Rate class | Mileage unlimited | Miles included for each rental day | Charge for each mile beyond the allowance, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | no | 125 | 0.32 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | no | 175 | 0.29 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | no | 200 | 0.25 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0 | 0 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | yes | 0 | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | no | 250 | 0.22 |

## How the three columns hang together

A class carrying unlimited mileage grants no allowance and publishes no excess rate; its included figure and
its excess rate are both nothing, and that is the whole of its mileage terms. A class not carrying unlimited
mileage publishes both an allowance for each rental day and a rate for each mile beyond it, and the two move
together across the schedule: the class with the smallest allowance at 125 miles carries the dearest excess
rate at 0.32 USD a mile, and the class with the largest allowance at 250 miles the cheapest at 0.22 USD.

## An allowance worked out

Take a hypothetical hire of four rental days on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate. The allowance for that hire is
200 miles for each of the four days, which is 800 miles in all. A hypothetical hire of the same four days on
the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate carries 250 miles a day, which is 1000 miles. Every mile beyond those
figures is charged at the class's own rate, 0.25 USD and 0.22 USD respectively. The same four days on the
Inclusive Flex Rate carry no allowance figure at all, because the class does not limit the miles driven.
